_readme: Seed data for the BTO launches feature. One launch object per BTO sales exercise. TO SEED A NEW LAUNCH: follow the curation runbook in BTO.plan.md section 8 at the repo root step by step (finding the Annex A PDF, extraction, geocoding, sanity checks, the reused-project-name check, verification) — don't wing it from memory, the URL patterns and edge cases in there were each hit for real. resale_flat_type values must exactly match transactions.flat_type ('2 ROOM','3 ROOM','4 ROOM','5 ROOM','MULTI-GENERATION'). Prices are 99-year-lease indicative prices, excluding grants, as officially quoted by HDB unless the launch has not happened yet (see section 8.9 for provisional/unofficial launches).

REPLACE all of this with real data from BTO.plan.md's curation runbook once HDB's official Annex A is published after the launch.

launches.label: June 2024 BTO
launches._curation_note: Predates HDB's Oct 2024 Standard/Plus/Prime classification framework — this launch used the older Non-Mature Estate / Mature Estate / Prime Location Public Housing Model (PLH) system, preserved as-is in each project's classification field rather than force-mapped to the newer terms (frontend falls back to the neutral 'Standard' badge color for any unrecognized classification string, but still displays the real label). Admin-details annex (Annex B) could not be recovered — HDB's live URL for this launch 404s post-redesign and the Wayback Machine only archived a dead revisit for it; application dates below are from the press release text instead.

projects.location_desc: Marsiling Lane. Two phases (Peak I & II) sharing one flat-supply/pricing table in HDB's Annex A; waiting time is 35 months for Peak I and 54 months for Peak II — the higher figure is stored here.

Sampan Place. Two phases (Riverfront I & II) sharing one flat-supply/pricing table; waiting time is 48 months for Riverfront I and 55 months for Riverfront II — the higher figure is stored here. The combined 4-Room row spans two floor-plan variants (89 sqm and 92 sqm); 90 sqm (midpoint) is stored since Annex A gives one combined unit count, not a per-variant split.

launches.label: February 2024 BTO
launches._curation_note: Predates HDB's Oct 2024 Standard/Plus/Prime classification framework — this launch used the older Non-Mature Town / Mature Town / Prime Location Public Housing Model (PLH) system, preserved as-is in each project's classification field (using the exact wording Annex A itself uses, which is 'Town' here vs 'Estate' in the June 2024 launch's own Annex A — HDB's own terminology wasn't perfectly consistent launch to launch). Frontend falls back to the neutral 'Standard' badge color for any unrecognized classification string, but still displays the real label. The press release's headline 5,714-flat figure includes 1,588 separate Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) units not seeded here; only the 4,126 BTO-exercise flats across these 7 projects are in flats[].

launches._curation_note: Predates HDB's Oct 2024 Standard/Plus/Prime classification framework — used the older Non-Mature Town(s) / Mature Town / Prime Location Public Housing Model (PLH) system, preserved as-is. Application window was extended to 9 days (vs the usual 7) for this exercise. Annexes recovered via Wayback Machine. This launch's Annex A omits the per-project Estimated Waiting Time column present in other launches — waiting_months is null for every project here rather than fabricated. Garden Waterfront @ Tengah's town (TENGAH) has zero rows in our own transactions table (same situation as Parc Meadow @ Tengah, May 2023) — its town-level comps fallback will be empty; the 1000m/2000m radius rungs may still surface nearby comps. 'Garden Waterfront I & II @ Tengah' is two phases sharing one combined pricing table, same pattern as Costa Riviera I & II — combined into one entry.

launches.label: August 2022 BTO
launches._curation_note: Predates HDB's Oct 2024 Standard/Plus/Prime classification framework — used the older Non-Mature Town(s) / Mature Town(s) / Prime Location Public Housing Model (PLH) system, preserved as-is. This launch used a 4-annex scheme (A=project info + main pricing table, B=2-Room Flexi lease-tenure table, C=PLH model summary, D=admin details) — pricing sourced from Table A(1)(h) inside Annex A itself, not a separate 'Annex B'. No Estimated Waiting Time column was published for this launch — waiting_months is null for every project. Jurong East Breeze geocodes almost evenly between Bukit Batok and Jurong East by nearby block count (262 vs 125 within 500m) — town is set to JURONG EAST per the project's own name and the press release's official town list (Ang Mo Kio, Bukit Merah, Choa Chu Kang, Jurong East, Tampines, Woodlands), overriding the closer-call geocode heuristic.
